svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
K4 on the sculpture: 4 letters ending one carved line, then three lines of 31; one shift per line, a 7-letter word over the columns
places 22 and 29: same column of a 7-letter word, same carved line, yet they need 1 and 23: dead
cells show copper minus message (last digit) on the sculpture's alphabet
31,994 word lengths x stretch lengths x offsets, four tables each
any word length, stretch, offset: 1+ checks
